fields.name: rangerAdminUsername
fields.label: Ranger Admin username
fields.help: Admin user KDPS uses to create the plugin repository and policies on this Ranger. Enter it (with the password below) to have KDPS talk to Ranger DIRECTLY over REST — required for an EXTERNAL Ranger, and also usable for a managed/internal one when you'd rather KDPS own the credential than delegate to the Ambari server.

fields.name: rangerAdminPassword
fields.label: Ranger Admin password
fields.help: Admin password paired with the username above. When BOTH are set, every Ranger operation (repository creation, policy/grant creation) for services wired to this context runs directly against ranger Admin URL. Leave BOTH blank on a managed context to keep delegating those operations to the Ambari server, which holds the credential (the pre-existing behaviour).

fields.name: caCert
fields.label: Ranger Admin CA certificate (PEM)
fields.help: CA chain that signed this Ranger's TLS certificate. Deployed plugins trust it in addition to the hosting Ambari CA. Left blank, KDPS pins the chain the server presents at deploy time and says so in the log.

fields.name: auditSolrEnabled
fields.label: Audit to Solr
fields.help: Whether the plugins of this Ranger write their audit events to Solr. Services KDPS deploys with a Ranger plugin (Trino, for one) follow it, unless their wizard overrides it. For a MANAGED or REMOTE context KDPS reads it from ranger-env.

fields.name: auditSolrUrls
fields.label: Audit Solr URLs
fields.help: Solr endpoint(s) the audit events are sent to, comma separated. Used when Solr runs without ZooKeeper; leave blank for a SolrCloud described by the ZooKeeper field below.

fields.name: auditSolrZookeepers
fields.label: Audit Solr ZooKeeper
fields.help: ZooKeeper connection string (with chroot) of the SolrCloud that stores the audit events. Leave blank when Solr is reached through its URLs.

fields.name: auditSolrCollection
fields.label: Audit Solr collection
fields.help: Name of the Solr collection that holds the audit events.

fields.name: auditHdfsEnabled
fields.label: Audit to HDFS
fields.help: Whether the plugins of this Ranger write their audit events to HDFS. Services KDPS deploys with a Ranger plugin follow it, unless their wizard overrides it. For a MANAGED or REMOTE context KDPS reads it from ranger-env.

fields.name: auditHdfsDir
fields.label: Audit HDFS directory
fields.help: Directory the audit files are written to, with the file system in front of it. The service needs the cluster's Hadoop configuration (core-site and hdfs-site) to resolve it.
